confirmReturnedToOsHelp: Confirm that all {{count}} selected parcels have physically been handed back to the shop. Their COD credit updates automatically; no wallet money is received.
paymentStorageUnavailable: Payment recovery data cannot be read or saved in this browser. Payments are paused. Enable browser session storage and reload; if recovery data is damaged, check payment history with support before clearing it.
paymentReasonTooLong: Keep the correction reason within 500 characters.
paymentWholeAmounts: Enter a whole, non-negative MMK amount in each wallet (use 0 for unused wallets).
paymentNoteRequired: Enter a note with at least 3 characters.
paymentReasonRequired: Enter a correction reason with at least 3 characters.
paymentAmountRequired: Enter a payment amount or apply available OS credit.
paymentExceedsPayable: Wallet payments exceed the amount to settle after OS credit.
paymentRetryUnchanged: The payment result is uncertain. Retry this same request to confirm it without creating a duplicate.
manifestCodReview: Parsed COD: {{total}} MMK · {{count}} rows need review. Compare columns and total with your PDF before saving.
manifestTruncated: Only part of the PDF was extracted. Check for missing pages or rows before saving.
draftStorageUnavailable: This device could not save your draft. Keep this page open until you save the parcels.
parcelSaveChunk: Save handles 500 parcels at a time. {{count}} additional ready rows will remain as drafts for the next save.
manifestNotSaved: Nothing has been saved. Review the extracted rows before adding them to the editable parcel grid.
manifestDraftApplied: {{count}} rows added to the editable grid. Review township and required fields before saving.
overview: Here’s what’s happening with your delivery operation today.
recordDeliveredHelp: Choose who received the customer's money for this parcel.
deliveredRiderCollectedHelp: Normal delivery. The rider's COD and delivery-fee handover will appear in Finance.
deliveredPaidToOsHelp: The online shop received this parcel's money. This creates OS credit; no money is received into a wallet.
includeFullDeliveryFee: Include the full delivery fee in OS credit
includeFullDeliveryFeeHelp: Add {{amount}} MMK where this shop's agreement includes the delivery fee.
osCreditAutoOffsetHelp: Available OS credit automatically reduces the next batch advance for this shop and hub. Any unused credit carries forward.
paidToOsSaved: Delivered parcel recorded as paid to OS. OS credit is available for the next advance.
grossProfitDescription: Delivery-fee revenue less rider commission from posted journal entries.
activeBatchesDescription: Latest pickup batches and delivery progress.
allBatchesDescription: Open a batch or filter the dispatch queue. Remaining counts exclude delivered and returned parcels.
operationsReturnQueueDescription: Review failed, rejected, partial, and pending returns. Due dates apply after a parcel enters Pending return.
returnQueueLoadError: Could not load the operations return queue.
parcelEditDisabled: Edit is available for Created, Picked up, or Assigned parcels that are not linked.
parcelContactOnly: You can correct the order reference and customer contact details. Township, zone, and COD are locked for this parcel.
fieldHistoryLoadError: Parcel field history could not be loaded.
noFieldHistory: No parcel field changes have been recorded.

parcelUpdateError.MONEY_POSTED: This parcel has posted money entries. Finance must reverse them before it can be changed.
parcelUpdateError.ADVANCE_POSTED: COD, delivery fee, and township cannot be changed after the batch pickup advance is posted.
parcelUpdateError.PARCEL_NOT_EDITABLE: This parcel is read-only because only Created, Picked up, or Assigned parcels can be edited.
parcelUpdateError.PARCEL_LINKED: Unlink this parcel before editing its delivery details.

loginDescription: Sign in to your operations workspace.
sessionExpiredHelp: Sign in again to save your work. What you already typed stays on this page.
riderAppDescription: Hi {{name}}. Delivery work runs in the mobile rider app, not this web dashboard.
riderAppDownloadTitle: Download the rider APK directly from this page.
riderAppDownloadBody: Use this page to install the current rider build on an Android phone. The APK is hosted on lotaya.mmds.site and can be downloaded without the Play Store.
riderAppHighlightMobileBody: The APK opens straight into the rider work queue, delivery updates, and settlement screens.
riderAppHighlightOfflineBody: The app keeps the rider workflow focused and avoids ERP-only screens that do not belong on the phone.
riderAppHighlightSecureBody: Only the published APK link is exposed here, so riders install the exact release you uploaded.
riderAppInstallHelp: On Android, enable Install unknown apps for the browser you use to open the APK. Then tap the download link above.
riderAppSecurityNoteBody: The page is intended for sideloaded internal releases. Keep the APK and version manifest in sync before sharing the link.
riderAppDevSteps: No APK is published yet. After deploy, riders download the APK from this page. Enable Install unknown apps for Chrome, then open the APK.
riderApkInstallHint: Install this APK on the rider phone. When we publish a newer version, the app will offer a download. You do not need the Play Store.
riderAppDevAndroid: Press a in the Expo CLI, or scan the QR code with Expo Go
riderAppWebBlocked: Rider accounts cannot access the ERP dashboard from the web.
operationsDescription: Manage parcels, exceptions, and return queues.
financeDescription: Wallet reconciliation and double-entry ledger visibility.
settingsDescription: Manage language, theme, and workspace preferences.
profileDescription: Review your account details and access level.
linkParcelsExplanation: Link {{count}} parcels and assign all of them to the responsible rider. The highest parcel fee becomes the base fee, plus 1,000 MMK per additional parcel.
unlinkParcelsExplanation: Financial entries already posted for this group will be reversed and recalculated as individual parcels.
osOutstandingExplanation: Batch product COD minus advances, payments, and confirmed full-COD returns. Delivery fees are tracked separately.
oldestFirstAllocation: Payments are allocated to selected batches oldest first.
paymentCorrectionReason: Why is this payment being corrected?
osPaymentVoided: Payment voided. Record the corrected replacement payment if needed.
selectAtLeastTwoForLink: Select at least two parcels to link.
selectedParcelsNotLinkable: Selected parcels must be unlinked and cannot be Delivered or Returned.
sameAddressRequired: All selected parcels must have the same normalized address.
sameDeliveryFeeRequired: All selected parcels must have the same base delivery fee.
sameRiderRequired: All selected parcels must have the same rider.
assignmentSelectionHint: Only unassigned Created or Picked up parcels can be dispatched.
correctRiderDescription: Reverse the posted receivable on the wrong rider and re-post it on the correct rider. The parcel stays Delivered.

correctRiderError.PARCEL_NOT_DELIVERED: Correct rider is only available for delivered parcels.
correctRiderError.PARCEL_LINKED: Unlink this parcel before correcting its rider.
correctRiderError.MONEY_POSTED: Finance collection is already posted. Reverse it before correcting the rider.
correctRiderError.RECOGNITION_NOT_FOUND: No posted rider receivable exists for this delivery.
correctRiderError.PARCEL_NOT_REASSIGNABLE: Use Correct rider for delivered parcels.
correctRiderError.HUB_MISMATCH: The rider must belong to the same hub as the parcel.
correctRiderError.ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT: The parcel changed while you were editing. Refresh and try again.
correctRiderError.DAY_CLOSED: The cashbook day for this delivery is closed. Reopen it or choose another business date.
correctRiderError.PARCEL_UNASSIGNED: This parcel has no rider assigned.

postPickupAdvancesDescription: Confirm the batch and funding wallet before posting immutable advance entries.
postPickupAdvancesHelp: These earlier advances have not yet reduced a wallet. Confirm the wallet only if this payment still needs recording. New batch advances are recorded automatically.
postPickupAdvancesStep2: 2. Choose the wallet you paid from
osCashbookSnapshotDescription: Track OS credit that automatically reduces the next pickup advance.
osCreditAvailableHint: Paid-to-OS deliveries and confirmed physical returns create credit. It offsets the next advance for the same shop and hub.
confirmPickupAdvancesDescription: Confirm where this earlier advance was paid from. This deducts the amount from that wallet once.
pickupAdvancesAlreadyPosted: Pickup advances were already posted for this batch.
financialReportDescription: Review server-calculated ledger balances for the selected period and account.
verifiedAccount: Identity verified by the active server session
name: Name
passwordMinimum: Password must contain at least eight characters.
reasonCodeManagementDescription: Configure localized reasons used for delivery exceptions.
reasonCodesLoadError: Reason codes could not be loaded. Try again before recording the outcome.
createBatchDescription: Save the batch first, then add parcels in the fast-entry grid.
requiredWalletAdvance: Remaining amount to pay from wallets
advanceWalletSplitMismatch: Enter exactly {{amount}} MMK across Cash, KBZ Pay, and Wave Pay after OS credit is applied.
loadingOsCredit: Checking this shop's available OS credit…
osCreditUnavailable: Could not check available OS credit. Retry before saving the advance.
checkRequiredFields: Check the required fields and try again.
batchEntryDescription: Paste spreadsheet rows or enter parcels with the keyboard. Delivery fees come from the selected township.
pasteGridHint: Paste tab-separated spreadsheet rows or CSV: order ID, customer, address, region, district, township, zone, phone, COD. Tracking numbers are assigned automatically.
parcelGridValidation: Incomplete rows will remain as drafts. Complete customer, address, township, and COD to include a row when saving.
cashbookExpensesDescription: Record categorized expenses as balanced wallet movements.
downloadManifestDescription: Filter by rider, status, and pickup date to review delivery details, then download a PDF if needed.
dailyDeliveryStatusDescription: Review rider outcomes for hub settlement without downloading a PDF.
formEntryHint: Enter one parcel at a time. Next keeps the form open for the next parcel.
remainingToOsHint: COD minus recorded advances, payments, confirmed returns and historical settlement, plus approved adjustments. Delivery fees are separate.
deliveryFeeEditorDescription: Select one or more townships and set a shared delivery fee.
dispatchQueueDescription: Dense parcel board for assign, status, and manifest actions.
failedDeliveryNextStepHelp: {{tracking}} is marked failed. Choose its next operational step.
returnToOsAfterFailureNote: Failed delivery sent to Return to OS queue
cancelledDeliveryHelp: A customer cancellation is recorded as Rejected, then appears in the Return to OS queue for the same return-list workflow.
cancelledToReturnNote: Customer cancellation moved to Return to OS
cancelledMovedToReturn: Cancelled parcel moved to the Return to OS queue.
customerCancelledHelp: Record it as Rejected and send it straight to the Return to OS queue.
returnListEligibilityHelp: Select only Rejected or Pending return parcels to generate an OS return list.
osReturnListHelp: Review the branded handover list before downloading its PDF.
returnListPreviewError: The OS return-list preview could not be loaded.
returnListNoPostingHelp: Downloading this list does not mark any parcel as physically returned or create an OS credit.
codCannotExceedOriginal: Collected COD cannot exceed the original amount.
partialBulkDisabled: Partial return cannot be applied in bulk — use the row status control.
reasonRequired: A reason code is required for this status.
bulkStatusCap: Bulk status is limited to 50 parcels.
riderOutstandingDescription: Review the selected day's expected remittance and record verified payments manually.
previousBatchSettlementsDescription: Review prior OS batch components before creating and posting a settlement statement.
dateChangeAlertDescription: Some parcels may fail when the customer asks to receive them on a different day. Reschedule or reassign these parcels.
walletAdjustmentDescription: Set the actual balance in hand. The difference is recorded as an auditable adjustment; history is never overwritten.
walletAdjustmentReasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
selectHubBeforeWalletAdjustment: Select the hub for this wallet adjustment.
riderOutstandingExplanation: Delivered means the rider owes the collected COD and fees; it does not mean the office has received the money. Record the verified Cash, KBZ Pay and Wave Pay amounts only when the rider settles.
paymentExceedsOutstanding: Payment cannot exceed the rider's outstanding amount.
noOutstandingRiders: No rider money is awaiting settlement for this date.
osSettlementWorkspaceDescription: Choose one shop and one or more eligible completed batches. Review every component before posting an immutable settlement.
osSettlementCoverageRule: Settlement requires collected COD to exceed advance paid plus returned advances (including previously settled returns for the shop).
selectShopForSettlement: Select an online shop to review eligible previous batches and settlement history.
noSettlementBatches: No batches are available for this online shop.
settlementHistoryLoadError: Settlement history could not be loaded.
noSettlementHistory: No settlement has been posted for this online shop.
immutableSettlementNotice: After posting, this statement cannot be edited. Corrections require a reasoned, audited reversal and a new settlement.
osSettlementPosted: The OS settlement was posted successfully.
osPendingReturnsDescription: Parcels awaiting physical return to the hub. Receiving marks them returned and posts only the recoverable advance deduction—no wallet credit.
osPendingReturnsLoadError: Pending returns could not be loaded.
noOsPendingReturns: No parcels are awaiting OS return recovery for these filters.
confirmReceiveReturnDescription: Mark {{tracking}} as returned and post a recoverable deduction of {{recoverable}}? No wallet credit is posted.
confirmReceivePartialReturnDescription: Mark {{tracking}} as returned. Original advance {{advance}}; already offset {{priorOffset}}; remaining recoverable {{recoverable}}. No wallet credit is posted.
osReturnReceived: Return received and recoverable deduction posted.
reverseSettlementDescription: Reverse {{shop}} settlement of {{amount}}? This creates a compensating journal and preserves the original statement.
osSettlementReversed: The settlement was reversed and its batches can be settled again.
overviewLoadError: The overview could not be loaded. Check the server connection and try again.
userManagementDescription: Create accounts, control access, and reset passwords. Changes are audited and may end active sessions.
strongPasswordRequired: Use 12+ characters with uppercase, lowercase, and a number.
validUsernameRequired: Use 3–50 letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens.
hubRequiredForRole: Select a hub for this role.
passwordResetSessionNotice: The old password and active sessions will stop working immediately.
statusSessionNotice: Changing access status is audited and ends the user’s active sessions.
profitBreakdownDescription: See the revenue, rider costs, expenses, adjustments, and journals behind profit.
selectHubForProfit: Select a hub to load its profit report.
profitLoadError: The profit report could not be loaded.
returnsExcludedFromProfit: Return advance recovery is a balance-sheet recovery and is not included in profit.
profitEmpty: No profit-affecting journals were posted in this period.
validMyanmarPhoneRequired: Enter a valid Myanmar mobile number.
savedSettlementDraftsDescription: Resume a reviewed statement without losing its selected batches or component values.
amendmentReversalWarning: This does not overwrite the posted statement. The system will reverse it and post a replacement settlement with a full audit record.
operationalReportsDescription: Review monthly operations, returns, rider outcomes, and online-shop settlements.
selectHubForReport: Select a hub to run this report.
detailedReportLoadError: This report could not be loaded.
noReportData: No records match this report period and filters.
overdueUnsentDescription: {{count}} unresolved parcels have been in your hands for at least three days.
paymentCorrected: Payment corrected. The original remains in history.
atomicCorrectionExplanation: Review the replacement below. The original payment is reversed only when this replacement succeeds.
draftRestored: Your unfinished parcel draft was restored.
rowNeedsCod: Enter COD as a whole number
overdueUnsentCardDetail: Older parcels that still need assignment or dispatch.
batchFinalized: Batch finalized. Finance can now record the actual advance.
finalizeBatchExplanation: Lock {{count}} saved parcels with total COD {{cod}} MMK and create the OS payable. Add or correct parcels before continuing.
selectHubForOsAccounts: Choose a hub before viewing or recording OS balances. Payments never cross hubs.
outForDeliveryWithRider: Out for delivery — physically with rider
advanceAutomaticHelp: Enter the requested total first. Available OS credit is applied automatically; enter only the remaining amount actually paid from the wallets. Saving the batch posts the wallet payments immediately.
rescheduleHelp: Parcels stay in their original batch. Their age continues from the first recorded date.
batchAccountBreakdown: COD {{cod}} · Advance {{advance}} · Payments {{paid}} · Returns {{returns}} · Historical {{historical}} · Adjustment {{adjustment}}
